# Search Field

> A search input with a button that clears it, and Escape that does the same.

`<slab-search-field>` · Form · built on `<input type=search>`

Docs: https://slab-elements.dev/components/search-field/

## Import

```js
import 'slab-elements/search-field.js';
```

## Usage

```html
<search>
  <slab-search-field label="Search" name="q"></slab-search-field>
</search>
```

The input is a native search input, so screenreaders read it as a search box and phones show a search key. The clear button shows only while there's something to clear and the field can be changed. It's left out of the tab order, since Escape clears the input too, and clearing it puts focus back in the input and dispatches `input` and `change` the way typing does. The browser's own clear button, which Chrome and Safari draw and Firefox doesn't, is hidden so there's one that works the same everywhere.

Escape clears in every browser, not only in those that do it natively. When the field is already empty, Escape is left alone, so a dialog or popover around it still closes. Wrap the field, or the form it's in, in a `<search>` element to make a search landmark. Set `clear-label` to rename the button, or register `searchFieldClear` for another language.
`selectionStart`, `selectionEnd`, `selectionDirection`, `select()`, `setSelectionRange()` and `setRangeText()` work as they do on a native search input. Like a native input's, `setRangeText()` dispatches no "input" or "change".

## Keyboard

| Key           | What it does                                                                                    |
| ------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Escape        | Clears the input. When it's already empty, does nothing, so it reaches what's around the field. |
| Enter         | Submits the form.                                                                               |
| Anything else | What it does on a native search input.                                                          |

## Elements

### `<slab-search-field>`

Import `slab-elements/search-field.js` to register it.

A search field with no visual styles, around a native search input, and a button beside it that clears what's been typed.

The input is `type="search"`, so screenreaders read it as a search box and phones show a search key. The browser's own clear button, which only some browsers draw, is hidden so there's one that works the same everywhere. Slab's is only there while there's something to clear and the field can be changed. It's left out of the tab order, as Escape does the same from the input, so tabbing goes from the search straight to whatever's after it. Clearing focuses the input again and dispatches "input" and "change", as typing does.

Escape clears the input in every browser, not only in those that do it natively. When there's nothing to clear, Escape is left alone, so a dialog or popover the field is in still closes on it.

Put it in a `<search>` element, or a `<form role="search">`, to make a search landmark. The landmark belongs around the whole search, not the field.

The label and the input are both in the shadow root, so a plain `for` reference names it without crossing out of one. The host delegates focus, so clicking anywhere on it, or a `<label for>` pointing at it, focuses the input.

Validity is the native input's. `required`, `minlength`, `maxlength` and `pattern` are passed through to it, and whatever it decides is mirrored onto the host, so `valueMissing`, `tooShort` and `patternMismatch` all mean what they mean on an `<input>`. Nothing is computed twice.

Style it through its parts and through `:state(disabled)`, `:state(error)`, `:state(empty)`, `:state(readonly)` and `:state(required)`. Where the label sits relative to the input, and the button relative to it, is layout, so it's left to the styles around it.

#### Attributes

| Name               | Type                               | Default | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| ------------------ | ---------------------------------- | ------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `label` (required) | `string`                           |         | Names it. It's the accessible name, and the visible label where there is one.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `autocomplete`     | `HTMLInputElement['autocomplete']` |         | What the browser may fill it with, as a native input's `autocomplete` says.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `clear-label`      | `string`                           |         | The clear button's text and so its accessible name. "Clear search" in English when unset.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `disabled`         | `boolean`                          | `false` | Disables it, as `disabled` does a native control: the user can't focus or use it, and a form control's value isn't submitted.                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `hide-label`       | `boolean`                          | `false` | Hides the label visually and leaves it as the accessible name, for a design that shows the label some other way.                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `maxlength`        | `number`                           |         | The most characters the user can type, as a native input's `maxlength`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `minlength`        | `number`                           |         | The fewest characters a valid value has, as a native input's `minlength`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `name`             | `string`                           | `''`    | The name its value is submitted under, as a native control's `name`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `pattern`          | `string`                           |         | A regular expression a valid value matches, as a native input's `pattern`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `placeholder`      | `string`                           |         | Shown while it's empty, as a native input's `placeholder`. It's a hint, not a label.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `readonly`         | `boolean`                          | `false` | Lets the user select the value but not change it, as `readonly` does a native input. The value is still submitted.                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `required`         | `boolean`                          | `false` | Makes it invalid while it has no value, as `required` does a native control.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `value`            | `string`                           | `''`    | Like a native input, the attribute is the default value and the property is the current one, so the attribute doesn't change as the field is typed into.                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `custom-validity`  | `string`                           |         | Makes it invalid with this message, as `setCustomValidity()` does, and shows the message at once rather than once validity is reported, for an error the page already knows about, such as one from a server. Removing it, or setting it to an empty string, makes it valid again, unless something else makes it invalid. |

#### Properties

| Name                            | Type                                     | Description                                                                                                                                                                                |
| ------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `defaultValue`                  | `string`                                 | The value it starts with, and goes back to when its form resets. It's the `value` attribute, as a native input's `defaultValue` is, so setting it sets the attribute, and `value` with it. |
| `selectionDirection`            | `HTMLInputElement['selectionDirection']` | Which way the selection was made, "forward", "backward" or "none", as a native input's `selectionDirection` is.                                                                            |
| `selectionEnd`                  | `number \| null`                         | Where the selection ends, or where the caret is when nothing is selected, as a native input's `selectionEnd` is.                                                                           |
| `selectionStart`                | `number \| null`                         | Where the selection starts, or where the caret is when nothing is selected, as a native input's `selectionStart` is.                                                                       |
| `form` (read-only)              | `HTMLFormElement \| null`                | The form it belongs to, or `null`.                                                                                                                                                         |
| `labels` (read-only)            | `NodeList`                               | The `<label>` elements associated with it, as a native control's `labels`: each `<label for>` that names its `id`, and a `<label>` around it.                                              |
| `validationMessage` (read-only) | `string`                                 | What's wrong, as the validity message says it: the message given to `setCustomValidity()` or `setValidity()`, or else the browser's own. Empty while it's valid.                           |
| `validity` (read-only)          | `ValidityState`                          | Its `ValidityState`, as a native control's.                                                                                                                                                |
| `willValidate` (read-only)      | `boolean`                                | Whether its validity is checked when its form submits. It isn't while it's disabled or read-only.                                                                                          |

#### Methods

| Signature                                                                                              | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `checkValidity(): boolean`                                                                             | Whether its value is valid. Dispatches "invalid" when it isn't, as a native control's does.                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `click(): void`                                                                                        | Clicks it, as a native element's `click()` does.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `focus(options?: FocusOptions): void`                                                                  | Focuses it, or the part of it that takes focus.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `reportValidity(): boolean`                                                                            | Whether its value is valid. When it isn't, dispatches "invalid" and shows the validity message, as a native control's does.                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `resetValidityFeedback(): void`                                                                        | Clears the validity feedback without changing `validity`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `select(): void`                                                                                       | Selects its text, as a native input's `select()` does.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| `setCustomValidity(message: string): void`                                                             | Makes it invalid with a message of your own, or valid again with an empty one, as a native control's does.                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `setRangeText(replacement: string, start?: number, end?: number, selectionMode?: SelectionMode): void` | Replaces part of its text, or the selection when `start` and `end` are left out, as a native input's `setRangeText()` does. `selectionMode` says what's selected afterward: "select", "start", "end" or "preserve", the default. Like a native input's, it dispatches no "input" or "change". |
| `setSelectionRange(start: number, end: number, direction?: 'forward' \| 'backward' \| 'none'): void`   | Selects part of its text, as a native input's `setSelectionRange()` does.                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `setValidity(flags?: ValidityStateFlags, message?: string): void`                                      | Sets its validity and message, as `ElementInternals.setValidity()` does, for checks of your own beyond `setCustomValidity()`.                                                                                                                                                                 |

#### Events

| Name      | Type    | Description                                                                                                                                                                             |
| --------- | ------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `input`   | `Event` | As the user changes its value, as a native control's does. Setting it from code doesn't dispatch it.                                                                                    |
| `change`  | `Event` | When the user changes its value, as a native control's does. Setting it from code doesn't dispatch it.                                                                                  |
| `invalid` | `Event` | When a check finds its value invalid, as a native control's does. Cancel it to leave the validity message unshown, after a blur, a submit or `reportValidity()`, and focus where it is. |

#### Slots

| Name               | Type                | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| ------------------ | ------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `description`      | `Element \| string` | Text that describes it, such as a hint or what the validity message means. It's its accessible description.                                                                                                                                                 |
| `validity-message` | `Element \| string` | Shown in place of the validity message's text while it's invalid and the message shows, for wording of your own, a translation, or a link. It's part of its accessible description, and `validationMessage` stays the browser's or `setCustomValidity()`'s. |

#### CSS parts

| Name               | Description                                                    |
| ------------------ | -------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `clear-button`     | The button that clears the input                               |
| `control`          | The input and the button, together                             |
| `description`      | Text about the field, and its validity message when it has one |
| `input`            | The input                                                      |
| `label`            | The label                                                      |
| `validity-message` | The validity message, which says why the value is invalid      |

#### CSS states

| Name               | Description                                                                                                               |
| ------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `:state(disabled)` | While it's disabled.                                                                                                      |
| `:state(empty)`    | While it has no value.                                                                                                    |
| `:state(error)`    | While it's invalid and its validity message shows, which is once its validity is reported, as when its form is submitted. |
| `:state(readonly)` | While it's read-only.                                                                                                     |
| `:state(required)` | While it's required, for styles such as an asterisk.                                                                      |
